verdict.rationale: AiPrise documents custom verification workflows, dashboard editing of the onboarding flow, and tunable decision thresholds. Nothing in the evidence covers versioning those workflows, reviewing changes to them, or rolling them back. The case-review and analyst-routing material concerns compliance cases, not changes to automations, so it is an adjacent feature that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
